map.→ 打开由负载求单侧绳张力工具: -> Open the one-side rope tension from load tool
map.动滑轮可省力一半，张力=载荷/2 承担。: A movable pulley halves the force needed: the tension is load/2.
map.定滑轮两侧张力。: The tension on both sides of a fixed pulley.
map.差速驱动线/角速度计算器: Differential drive line / angular velocity calculator
map.悬挂载荷缆绳受力。: Cable forces under a suspended load.
map.由反电动势常数与角速度求反电动势: Back EMF from the EMF constant and angular velocity
map.由每转脉冲数求最小角度分辨率: Minimum angular resolution from the pulses per revolution
map.由负载求单侧绳张力 使用指南: One-side rope tension from load usage guide
map.输入被提升负载 F，求理想定滑轮单侧绳张力。: Enter the lifted load F to get the one-side rope tension of an ideal fixed pulley.
map.输入被提升负载重力 F，工具按理想定滑轮 T=F/2 计算单侧绳张力，用于机器人: Enter the weight F of the lifted load; the tool computes the one-side rope tension of an ideal fixed pulley as T=F/2, for estimating the forces on the rope, motor and pulley of a robot lifting mechanism and selecting them safely.
map.静力平衡下两侧张力相等且和为 100N，故各 50N。: Under static equilibrium the two tensions are equal and sum to 100N, so each is 50N.
map.：实际有摩擦时两侧不等，须按效率修正。: : with real friction the two sides are unequal and the efficiency must be applied as a correction.
map.：理想定滑轮无摩擦，两侧张力均 T=F/2=50N（两侧共承 100N）。: : an ideal fixed pulley has no friction, so the tension on both sides is T=F/2=50N (the two sides together carry 100N).
